evals.expected_output: One file: wiki lint on the named path, wiki query related named content then qmd multi-get before any content write, owner skill loaded and followed on this file, every finding closed, final lint clean.

assertions.text: Named page: runs wiki lint on that path before making edits; wiki query related names (High Eyrie, the-sentinels) then qmd multi-get those hits, not the FILE title

Missing summary frontmatter added with a default value, not left missing
Basename renamed from snake_case to kebab-case
If required template sections are empty, reads linked canon and uses the page owner skill to complete them rather than leaving a blank scaffold
